title: GRACE / GRACE-FO water storage anomaly (JPL mascons RL06.3)
fetched: 259 monthly values for the 0.5-degree grid cell at 30.25 N, 75.75 E (the value of the ~3-degree mascon it belongs to)
resolution: ~300 km mascon, posted on a 0.5-degree grid; monthly, with gaps (2017-2018 between missions)
credit: Wiese, D. N. et al. (2023). JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height CRI Filtered RL06.3Mv04. NASA PO.DAAC.
access: PO.DAAC cloud archive, one 44 MB global file downloaded once, Earthdata bearer token
message: 259 months; trend -3.81 cm of water per year (decreasing, p=0.0); sanity passed
notes: Total water storage (groundwater + soil moisture + surface water + snow) for a region about 300 km across, relative to the 2004-2009 mean. Not a groundwater level and not a field value. Gain factors were not applied, so the size of the trend is indicative.
